name: Sleepover
source:
In the not-so-distant future, two girls experience the last Sleepover on Earth

A cosmic horror visual-novel about the last two humans alive. 'There is no point in living past tonight, so let's make some good memories before we leave together.'

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4549500/Sleepover/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在不远的将来，两个女孩经历了地球上最后一次过夜

一部关于最后两个活着的人类的宇宙恐怖视觉小说。“过了今晚就没有意义了，所以让我们在一起离开之前留下一些美好的回忆吧。”

[取自 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4549500/Sleepover/]Steam[/url]]
